## Reading the Data

We start by reading the data into R
```{r}
d = readRDS("../Data/SFHouses.rds")
```

We don't want to show the code for this next operation to the reader as we are just doing some
sanity checks. 
So we add `echo=FALSE` to the section:
```{r,echo=FALSE}
stopifnot(nrow(d) > 0)
stopifnot(class(d) == "data.frame")
stopifnot(inherits(d, "data.frame"))
```

Generally, I would include these in my report.

## Summary of the Data Frame

Next, we compute the number of rows and columns:
```{r}
dim(d)
```

We also compute the class of each column
```{r}
sapply(d, class)
```

## Plot

We plot sqft versus sale price/amount
```{r}
plot(d$sqft, d$amount)
```


Create the PDF file from the Rmd file:
```{r,eval=FALSE}
rmarkdown::render("eg.Rmd", "pdf_document")
```


Generate the R code from the Rmd file:
```{r, eval=FALSE}
knitr::purl("eg.Rmd", documentation = 0)
```

g = split(d, d$county)
